purpose: Authored development cases frozen before benchmark; not held-out or agent task-success evidence

skills.name: fault-isolation
skills.description: Investigate failures, reconnect problems, stale revisions, crashes and regression causes before changing code.

skills.name: interface-review
skills.description: Review contrast, keyboard navigation, screen reader labels and accessible focus behavior.

skills.name: release-check
skills.description: Verify version, changelog, packaging, release checklist and rollback readiness.

skills.name: data-change
skills.description: Plan database schema migration, backfill, rollback and compatibility tests.

skills.name: test-design
skills.description: Design regression tests, fixtures, edge cases and repeatable verification.

skills.name: code-inspection
skills.description: Review patches for correctness, security, maintainability and missing tests.

skills.name: documentation
skills.description: Write user guides, installation instructions, examples and reference documentation.

skills.name: dependency-map
skills.description: Identify module dependencies, ownership, boundaries and affected consumers.

cases.query: Check keyboard navigation and screen reader labels
Check changelog and packaging before release
Plan a database backfill and rollback
Design edge cases and regression fixtures
Review patches for correctness and security
Write installation instructions and user guides
Find affected consumers across module boundaries
Investigate reconnect failures and design regression tests
